description_expanded:
This 3rd floor condo offers incredible views over the amphitheatre and Town Center as well as a distant view of the Gulf from an expansive balcony. The condo features a spacious open-concept living and dining area, with floor-to-ceiling glass windows that flood the space with natural light. Guests will also find two beautifully appointed bedrooms. The Primary bedroom with a comfortable king bed and a private ensuite bathroom offers privacy as well as direct access to the balcony. The guest bedroom is equally inviting with a king bed, balcony access and a full bath conveniently located just across the hall. For your convenience, parking is provided directly behind the building in one reserved space. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Della 302. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
